text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I are on our way back
from an
outing, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Oguri Cap?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It is! I'm a big fan, Oguri! I went to your
last race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, thanks...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: What's your secret to running so fast?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Move your legs... as quickly as
you can.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That... makes sense. A bit simple, but
since you're
the one saying it, I guess it's
worth giving it a
shot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We'll get out of your way now! Sorry for

bothering you! And thanks for the
advice!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. Thanks to you guys too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri's fans go on their way, looking
pleased.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've never really given it much
thought.
But now that you mention it,
maybe.
choice_data_list: 人に囲まれるのは苦手？
choice_data_list_en: Are you uncomfortable being surrounded by people?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back in my hometown, there weren't a
lot of other
people around my age.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But the more I race, the more I notice
people
approaching me in public.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I should probably get better at
interacting with
them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Do you have any pointers?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Do you have any pointers?
choice_data_list: ときには荒療治も必要だ！
ときには荒療治も必要だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's think about it together!
Sometimes drastic measures are necessary too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm sure the two of us will be
able to
come up with some sort of plan.
choice_data_list: ときには荒療治も必要だ！
ときには荒療治も必要だよ！
choice_data_list_en: Alright, let's think about it together!
Sometimes drastic measures are necessary too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm a few sandwiches short of a picnic, so
I need
your help.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that not how you use the
phrase?
choice_data_list: そ、その言い方はちょっと違うような……
choice_data_list_en: I-I feel like that's not quite the right way to put it...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, what I mean is that tackling
something
like this will take time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm counting on you to help me
out—till
death do us part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside Oguri Cap's unusual choice
of
words, we decide to practice handling
situations
involving groups of people her
age.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I have to do something
about this.
Throwing myself into the
deep end might be hard,
but... if it's sink
or swim, then I'll swim!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So... what are we doing?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Bargain hunting, huh? I see... I'm sure
there'll be
lots of people doing the
same.
choice_data_list: タイムセールに行くぞ！
タイムセールに行くよ！
choice_data_list_en: We're going to the time sale!
We're going to the time sale!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I make our way to the
shopping
district, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing left... I guess we were
too late.

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You gotta move quickly when it
comes
to these sales!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. So it's kind of like a
race... I'll
be sure to start strong next
time.

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you race, miss?

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Here, take these. You and your trainer
should eat
them for energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're given two croquettes that were in
the sale.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank you! I'll give my next race

everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Throwing myself in the deep end
was a
good idea. I wasn't nervous even
with all those
people around me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And I even got to eat a croquette.
Thanks for the
help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not have been surrounded by
people her
age, but this experience still
seems to have
helped her.
